name: Reverse Demon Summoning
source:
Reverse Demon Summoning is a micro visual novel where instead of summoning a demon,  you, a human, are the one summoned to hell by a demon prince. Candles, magic circle and all. What is his purpose with you? Will you help him achieve his goals, or just try and get back home?

[From [url=https://barbieronpa.itch.io/reverse-demon-summoning]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《逆恶魔召唤》是一部微视觉小说，你作为人类，不是召唤恶魔，而是被恶魔王子召唤到地狱。蜡烛、魔法阵等等。他跟你在一起的目的是什么？你会帮助他实现目标，还是只是尝试回家？

[来自[url=https://barbieronpa.itch.io/reverse-demon-summoning]itch.io[/url]]
